title: David Choe and Joe Rogan Discuss the Revolutionary Work of Rick Doblin
summary: A 3:48 derivative from JRE #1965 about Rick Doblin, MAPS, psychedelic therapy, nonverbal intimacy and AI risk. Rapid opening overlap says both participants recently hosted Doblin, praises his decades of work and reports an age-18/19 commitment to psychedelic therapy. The primary storyteller says he made an NFT and donated it/all proceeds to MAPS, says psychedelics saved his life in a way Western therapy did not reach, and recounts inviting Doblin to The Choe Show. He describes redirecting a politician-mode interview into prolonged mutual face-touching while tripping, feeling a deeper nonverbal exchange, wanting fun and movement from head to heart, and speaking gibberish/Huttese/tongues when words and logic felt limiting. Another turn praises Doblin and advocates knowledgeable administration for many but explicitly not everyone. The close pivots to speculative AI autonomy and robot-overlord fear. Names/terms are repaired, but donation, chronology, regulatory status, treatment effects and encounter details remain self-report. The record supplies no medical protocol, substance/dose, provider definition, contraindications, AI forecast or named turns.
